usage: om secrets [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [--allow-unauthenticated]
                  {init,set,list,rekey,decrypt,migrate} [file] [destination]

positional arguments:
  {init,set,list,rekey,decrypt,migrate}
                        init, set, list, rekey, decrypt or migrate
  file                  decrypt / migrate: the old secret file
  destination           migrate: <project>/<name> to store the secret under (age)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o, --output OUTPUT   decrypt: write the plain text to this file instead of printing it
  --allow-unauthenticated
                        read an old om-v1 file, which has no integrity check
